parts.name: Cabinet Door
parts.Basic_description: This is the cabinet door made of MDF, forming the front access panel of the cabinet.
parts.Functional_description: It allows access to the interior storage space by swinging open or closed, typically attached with hinges.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates about a vertical axis via hinges when opened or closed.

parts.name: Cabinet Frame
parts.Basic_description: This is the main structural frame of the cabinet made of plywood, providing support and shape.
parts.Functional_description: It supports all other parts including the door, shelves, and base, maintaining the cabinet’s rigidity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and provides structural stability.

parts.name: Shelf (Top)
parts.Basic_description: This is the top shelf inside the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It provides a flat surface for storing items within the cabinet.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed in place and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Middle)
parts.Basic_description: This is the middle shelf of the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It divides the storage space and supports stored items.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Shelf (Bottom)
parts.Basic_description: This is the bottom shelf of the cabinet made of particle board.
parts.Functional_description: It supports heavier items and forms the lower storage surface.
parts.Movement_description: It is fixed and does not move during normal use.

parts.name: Cabinet Base
parts.Basic_description: This is the base of the cabinet made of plywood, supporting the entire structure.
parts.Functional_description: It provides stability and elevation from the floor, distributing the cabinet’s weight evenly.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and supports the cabinet’s load.
